# Fetch reviews for candidate t-shirt product_ids from last calendar month orders.

def fetch_all_reviews(product_id, user_email, page_limit=20):
    page_index = 0
    all_reviews = []
    while True:
        resp = apis.amazon.show_product_reviews(
            product_id=product_id,
            user_email=user_email,
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=page_limit
        )
        if not resp:
            break
        # api likely returns list or dict; normalize
        reviews = resp if isinstance(resp, list) else resp.get('success', [])
        if not reviews:
            break
        all_reviews.extend(reviews)
        page_index += 1
    return all_reviews

user_email = 'les_ball@gmail.com'
product_ids = [257, 140]

results = {}
for pid in product_ids:
    reviews = fetch_all_reviews(pid, user_email)
    results[pid] = reviews
    print('product_id', pid, 'reviews_count', len(reviews))
    for r in reviews:
        title = r.get('title')
        text = r.get('text')
        combined = (title or '') + ' ' + (text or '')
        has_gray = ('gray' in combined.lower() or 'grey' in combined.lower())
        print('  review_id', r.get('review_id'), 'rating', r.get('rating'), 'created_at', r.get('created_at'), 'gray_mentioned', has_gray, 'title', title)
